purpose: independent check of the Python Mellin/Poisson twisted Epstein sums (U156_twist.Zs): one-direction closed forms (n3 or n1 sum in closed form, n_perp box |n_i| <= 25, exponential convergence for alternating n3)
code: s1[a_] := Pi/(Sqrt[a] Sinh[Pi Sqrt[a]]); s2[a_] := -D[Pi/(Sqrt[x] Sinh[Pi Sqrt[x]]), x] /. x -> a; c1[a_] := Pi Coth[Pi Sqrt[a]]/Sqrt[a]; c2[a_] := -D[Pi Coth[Pi Sqrt[x]]/Sqrt[x], x] /. x -> a; M = 25; pts = Select[Tuples[Range[-M, M], 2], # =!= {0, 0} &]; z2PPA = -2 DirichletEta[4] + Total[N[s2[#.#], 30] & /@ pts]; z1PPA = -2 DirichletEta[2] + Total[N[s1[#.#], 30] & /@ pts]; y1PPA = 3 Total[N[#[[1]]^2 s2[#.#], 30] & /@ pts]; z2AAA = -2 DirichletEta[4] + Total[N[(-1)^(#[[1]] + #[[2]]) s2[#.#], 30] & /@ pts]; z1AAA = -2 DirichletEta[2] + Total[N[(-1)^(#[[1]] + #[[2]]) s1[#.#], 30] & /@ pts]; z2PAA = 2 Zeta[4] + Total[N[(-1)^(#[[1]] + #[[2]]) c2[#.#], 30] & /@ pts]; ToString[N[{...}, 12], InputForm]

Y1PPA: agree 6e-8 relative (Python uses a central finite difference in the metric, h = 2e-4)
Z2PAA: differ 3.3e-5: the Wolfram PAA form sums the NON-alternating periodic n1 in closed form, leaving a conditionally convergent alternating (n2,n3) box sum of ~A^(-3/2) (truncation ~1e-5); the Python Mellin value is exponentially convergent; N_C(PAA) 20.87092 vs 20.87083, v11 table 20.87
